## Update 1.3.5 Beta 1

**New Features:**
* GitHub repositories in Sources look like every other source: the repository's icon, its name, and when it last released
* Search in Sources finds your GitHub repositories too
* Long-press a GitHub repository to copy its link or open it in GitHub
* Better iPad layout: Settings, app pages and source app lists keep to a comfortable reading width on big screens
* On iPad, progress panels sit at the bottom without a gap and no longer stretch across the screen, and switching tabs fades the whole screen
* Onboarding's button and text no longer stretch edge to edge on iPad
